title: PromptProfile
description: A versioned, owner-declared prompt template with its variable and output schemas (ZTAX-AIGOV-001 §7; Master Specification Chapter 17 §14.3). Nothing may construct a Provenance naming a prompt profile that is not registered.
$comment: Required fields are exactly ztax_gateway.production_registries.PromptProfile. prompt_hash and evaluation_profile_id are the AIGOV-001 §7 fields the Python dataclass does not yet carry.

authority_ceiling.description: The highest authority outcome this prompt may produce. Never A5.

deprecated.description: A deprecated profile may not appear in a new release manifest.
